name: Instrument cluster (5G0 920 861 B)
description: Display settings of the instrument cluster, taken from the VCDS Long Coding Helper for this exact unit. Equipment, safety-warning, fuel tank and tyre settings are left out on purpose.

options.label: Needle sweep at start
options.description: The speedometer and rev counter needles swing to the end and back when the ignition is switched on.

options.label: Lap timer
options.description: Adds a lap timer to the display between the dials.

options.label: Speed warning at 120 km/h
options.description: A warning chime when the car passes 120 km/h (75 mph).

options.label: Distance
options.description: Unit for trip and range distances.

options.label: Digital speed
options.description: Unit for the digital speed display.

options.label: Pressure
options.description: Unit for pressures shown in the display.

options.label: Fuel consumption
options.description: Unit for the fuel consumption display.

options.label: Start screen
options.description: The picture between the dials when the ignition comes on. VCDS only numbers the versions; some may look the same or be blank on this cluster.

options.label: Compass at the bottom
options.description: Shows the compass at the bottom of the display instead of the top.

options.label: Show oil temperature
options.description: Adds the engine oil temperature to the trip computer pages.

options.label: Show acceleration
options.description: Adds an acceleration page to the trip computer.

options.label: Show refuel volume
options.description: Adds a page showing how many litres fit in the tank right now.
